# Generated by tools/gen_ucm_domicile.py from the base game's domicile buildings. Don't edit by hand.
# add_domicile_building ignores cost and construction time. Effects below take the domicile as scope,
# except ucm_domicile_holder_effect and ucm_domicile_preset_*_effect, which take a character.

ucm_domicile_add_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = $B$ } }
		add_domicile_building = $B$
	}
}

ucm_domicile_upgrade_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_domicile_building_or_higher = $FROM$
			NOT = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = $TO$ }
		}
		add_domicile_building = $TO$
	}
}

ucm_domicile_add_internal_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_domicile_building_or_higher = $PARENT$
			NOT = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = $B$ }
			domicile_building_has_free_internal_slot = $PARENT$
		}
		add_domicile_building = $B$
	}
}

ucm_domicile_lower_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_domicile_building = $B$ }
		lower_domicile_building_no_refund = $B$
	}
}

ucm_domicile_remove_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_domicile_building = $B$ }
		remove_domicile_building_no_refund = $B$
	}
}

# Saves the character whose estate a preset changes: the target, else, if the target has no domicile at all,
# their house head or oldest house member with one (administrative estates often sit with the noble family).
ucm_domicile_holder_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_alive = yes domicile ?= { OR = { is_domicile_type = estate is_domicile_type = east_asian_estate is_domicile_type = japanese_manor } } }
		save_scope_as = ucm_domicile_holder
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_domicile = no house.house_head ?= { is_alive = yes domicile ?= { OR = { is_domicile_type = estate is_domicile_type = east_asian_estate is_domicile_type = japanese_manor } } } }
		house.house_head = { save_scope_as = ucm_domicile_holder }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_domicile = no house ?= { any_house_member = { is_alive = yes domicile ?= { OR = { is_domicile_type = estate is_domicile_type = east_asian_estate is_domicile_type = japanese_manor } } } } }
		house = {
			ordered_house_member = {
				limit = { is_alive = yes domicile ?= { OR = { is_domicile_type = estate is_domicile_type = east_asian_estate is_domicile_type = japanese_manor } } }
				order_by = age
				save_scope_as = ucm_domicile_holder
			}
		}
	}
}

	ucm_domicile_east_asian_estate_clear_external_effect = yes
	ucm_domicile_add_1_6_effect = { T = east_asian_estate_rice_field }
	ucm_domicile_add_1_2_effect = { T = east_asian_estate_workshop }
	ucm_domicile_add_3_6_effect = { T = east_asian_estate_workshop_carpenter }
	ucm_domicile_add_1_2_effect = { T = east_asian_estate_storage }
	ucm_domicile_add_3_6_effect = { T = east_asian_estate_storage_warehouse }
	ucm_domicile_add_1_6_effect = { T = east_asian_estate_market }
	ucm_domicile_add_1_6_effect = { T = east_asian_estate_tea }
	ucm_domicile_add_1_6_effect = { T = east_asian_estate_silk }
	while = { count = 40 limit = { free_external_domicile_building_slots >= 1 } add_random_external_east_asian_estate_building = yes }
	ucm_domicile_east_asian_estate_upgrade_all_effect = yes
}

	ucm_domicile_japanese_manor_main_effect = yes
	ucm_domicile_japanese_manor_clear_external_effect = yes
	ucm_domicile_add_1_6_effect = { T = japanese_fields }
	ucm_domicile_add_1_6_effect = { T = japanese_workshop }
	ucm_domicile_add_1_6_effect = { T = japanese_tea_plantation }
	ucm_domicile_add_1_6_effect = { T = japanese_stables }
	ucm_domicile_add_1_6_effect = { T = japanese_tea_house }
	ucm_domicile_add_1_6_effect = { T = japanese_garden }
	while = { count = 40 limit = { free_external_domicile_building_slots >= 1 } add_random_external_japanese_manor_building = yes }
	ucm_domicile_japanese_manor_upgrade_all_effect = yes
}

	ucm_domicile_japanese_manor_main_effect = yes
	ucm_domicile_japanese_manor_clear_external_effect = yes
	ucm_domicile_add_1_6_effect = { T = japanese_fields }
	ucm_domicile_add_1_6_effect = { T = japanese_workshop }
	ucm_domicile_add_1_6_effect = { T = japanese_tea_plantation }

	ucm_domicile_japanese_manor_upgrade_all_effect = yes
}

ucm_domicile_preset_economy_effect = {
	ucm_domicile_holder_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:ucm_domicile_holder }
		scope:ucm_domicile_holder = {
			hidden_effect = {
				domicile = {
					switch = {
						trigger = is_domicile_type
						estate = { ucm_domicile_estate_economy_effect = yes }
						east_asian_estate = { ucm_domicile_east_asian_estate_economy_effect = yes }
						japanese_manor = { ucm_domicile_japanese_manor_economy_effect = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			remove_character_modifier = ucm_domicile_preset_economy_bonus_modifier
			remove_character_modifier = ucm_domicile_preset_military_bonus_modifier
			remove_character_modifier = ucm_domicile_preset_balanced_bonus_modifier
			add_character_modifier = ucm_domicile_preset_economy_bonus_modifier
		}
	}
}

ucm_domicile_preset_military_effect = {
	ucm_domicile_holder_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:ucm_domicile_holder }
		scope:ucm_domicile_holder = {
			hidden_effect = {
				domicile = {
					switch = {
						trigger = is_domicile_type
						estate = { ucm_domicile_estate_military_effect = yes }
						east_asian_estate = { ucm_domicile_east_asian_estate_military_effect = yes }
						japanese_manor = { ucm_domicile_japanese_manor_military_effect = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			remove_character_modifier = ucm_domicile_preset_economy_bonus_modifier
			remove_character_modifier = ucm_domicile_preset_military_bonus_modifier
			remove_character_modifier = ucm_domicile_preset_balanced_bonus_modifier
			add_character_modifier = ucm_domicile_preset_military_bonus_modifier
		}
	}
}

			remove_character_modifier = ucm_domicile_preset_military_bonus_modifier
			remove_character_modifier = ucm_domicile_preset_balanced_bonus_modifier
			add_character_modifier = ucm_domicile_preset_balanced_bonus_modifier
		}
	}
}
